metadata.module_description: System Basis Chip (SBC) Driver - NXP FS85xx MCU Supervisor

requirements.content: The SBC module shall provide a state machine with the following states: UNINITIALIZED, INITIALIZATION, RUNNING, and ERROR.
requirements.rationale: State machine enumeration SBC_STATEMACHINE_e defines core operational states for SBC control

requirements.content: The SBC state machine trigger function shall be called time-triggered every 10ms.
requirements.rationale: SBC_STATEMACHINE_TASK_CYCLE_CONTEXT_MS define and compile-time assertion enforce 10ms cycle time

requirements.content: The SBC trigger function shall implement re-entrance protection to prevent concurrent execution.
requirements.rationale: SBC_CheckReEntrance function ensures state machine is not re-entered during execution

requirements.content: Re-entrance check shall use OS critical section to atomically increment triggerEntry counter.
requirements.rationale: OS_EnterTaskCritical/OS_ExitTaskCritical used to protect triggerEntry counter access

requirements.content: The SBC instance pointer parameter shall be validated as non-NULL before processing.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT(pInstance != NULL_PTR) present at entry of all functions accepting SBC_STATE_s pointer

requirements.content: The SBC initialization request shall only be accepted when the state machine is in UNINITIALIZED state.
requirements.rationale: SBC_CheckStateRequest validates INIT_REQUEST only allowed from UNINITIALIZED state

requirements.content: The SBC shall return SBC_ALREADY_INITIALIZED if initialization is requested when already initialized.
requirements.rationale: Return type enumeration includes SBC_ALREADY_INITIALIZED for duplicate init requests

requirements.content: The SBC state request function shall use OS critical section to atomically update state request.
requirements.rationale: SBC_SetStateRequest uses OS_EnterTaskCritical/OS_ExitTaskCritical for atomic request update

requirements.content: The SBC shall count and track illegal state requests.
requirements.rationale: illegalRequestsCounter incremented when invalid request is pending

requirements.content: The SBC initialization shall transition to ERROR state if FS85 initialization fails after maximum retry count (3 retries).
requirements.rationale: Retry counter check with maximum of 3 retries before transitioning to ERROR state

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog shall be triggered periodically when in PERIODIC_WATCHDOG_ACTIVATED state.
requirements.rationale: SBC_TriggerWatchdogIfRequired called when watchdogState equals SBC_PERIODIC_WATCHDOG_ACTIVATED

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog trigger period shall be configurable with default period of 100ms.
requirements.rationale: SBC_WINDOW_WATCHDOG_PERIOD_MS defined as 100ms default watchdog period

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog counter shall be decremented each trigger cycle and watchdog refreshed when counter reaches zero.
requirements.rationale: SBC_TriggerWatchdogIfRequired decrements watchdogTrigger and calls FS85_TriggerWatchdog when zero

requirements.content: The SBC shall transition to RUNNING state after successful initialization including safety path checks.
requirements.rationale: State transition to RUNNING after SBC_INITIALIZE_SAFETY_PATH_CHECK substate completes successfully

requirements.content: The SBC state machine shall trap on invalid state in default case.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT(FAS_TRAP) in default case ensures invalid states cause assertion failure

requirements.content: The SBC state machine shall trap on invalid substate during initialization.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT(FAS_TRAP) in else branch of initialization substates catches invalid substates

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall verify LBIST (logical built-in self-test) and ABIST1 (analog built-in self-test) pass status.
requirements.rationale: FS85_InitializeFsPhase verifies FS8X_FS_LBIST_OK_PASS and FS8X_FS_ABIST1_OK_PASS

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall detect and report if debug mode is active.
requirements.rationale: Debug mode check sets FS85_DEBUG_MODE and reports via MINFO_SetDebugProbeConnectionState

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall verify no OTP CRC error exists.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_OTP_CORRUPT_NO_ERROR check ensures OTP memory integrity

requirements.content: The FS85 shall be configured to enter FS_INIT state if not already in that state.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_GO_TO_INITFS_GO_BACK_TO_INIT_FS written to transition SBC to FS_INIT state

requirements.content: The FS85 fail-safe registers shall be written using both DATA and DATA_NOT (inverted) for corruption detection.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WriteRegisterInit writes to FS_I_Register and FS_I_NOT_Register with inverted data

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog window period shall be configured to 128ms.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_WD_WINDOW_128MS configured in watchdog window register

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog window duty cycle shall be configured to 50%.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_WDW_DC_50 configured for 50% duty cycle

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog fault recovery shall be configured to 128ms.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_WDW_RECOVERY_128MS configured for watchdog recovery

requirements.content: The FS85 fault error counter limit shall be configured to 8.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_I_FLT_ERR_CNT_LIMIT_8 configured as maximum fault error count

requirements.content: The FS85 fault error counter reaching limit shall impact both FS0B and RSTB pins.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_I_FLT_ERR_IMPACT_FS0B_RSTB configured to assert both safety outputs on fault

requirements.content: The FS85 RSTB pulse duration shall be configured to 10ms.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_I_RSTB_DUR_10MS configured for reset pulse width

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall close INIT_FS phase by sending the first good watchdog refresh.
requirements.rationale: FS85_TriggerWatchdog called to close INIT_FS phase after configuration

requirements.content: The FS85 shall execute ABIST2 after closing INIT_FS and verify it passes within 1.2ms.
requirements.rationale: MCU_Delay_us(1200u) wait followed by FS8X_FS_ABIST2_OK_MASK verification

requirements.content: The FS85 shall clear all diagnostic flags in FS_DIAG_SAFETY register after ABIST2.
requirements.rationale: FS85_ClearRegisterFlags called to clear FCCU, ERRMON, WD, SPI, I2C error flags

requirements.content: The FS85 shall clear all voltage monitoring flags in FS_OVUVREG_STATUS register.
requirements.rationale: All VMON, VCOREMON, VDDIO OV/UV flags cleared in overvoltage/undervoltage status register

requirements.content: The fault error counter shall be cleared to zero by consecutive good watchdog refreshes before safety path check.
requirements.rationale: FS85_InitializeNumberOfRequiredWatchdogRefreshes calculates required refreshes to clear counter

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog refresh counter limit options shall be 1, 2, 4, or 6 refreshes.
requirements.rationale: Watchdog refresh limit enumeration values 1, 2, 4, 6 checked in configuration

requirements.content: The FS85 shall perform RSTB safety path check to verify external reset path functionality.
requirements.rationale: FS85_PerformPathCheckRstb verifies RSTB pin can bring safety outputs to known levels

requirements.content: The FS85 shall perform FS0B safety path check to verify fail-safe output functionality.
requirements.rationale: FS85_PerformPathCheckFs0b verifies FS0B pin can bring safety outputs to known levels

requirements.content: The FS85 FS0B pin shall only be released when not in debug mode.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_FS0B_Release only called when pInstance->mode != FS85_DEBUG_MODE

requirements.content: The FS85 FS0B release shall require fault error counter equals zero and LBIST/ABIST1/ABIST2 pass as preconditions.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_FS0B_Release checks errorCounter == 0 and all BIST pass flags before release

requirements.content: The FS85 FS0B release value shall be computed as reversed and complemented watchdog seed.
requirements.rationale: Bit reversal and complement of WD_SEED required for FS0B release authentication

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization state shall be persisted to NVRAM for power-cycle recovery.
requirements.rationale: FRAM_WriteData called to persist FS85_INITIALIZED phase to non-volatile memory

requirements.content: The FS85 shall detect short-circuit between FIN and RSTB pins during power-on reset.
requirements.rationale: FIN pin toggled low for 10us to detect short-circuit with RSTB; reset indicates short

requirements.content: The FS85 FIN state shall be persisted to NVRAM and reported via diagnostic handler.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_Handler and FRAM update for FIN state after short-circuit test

requirements.content: The FS85 shall verify RSTB assertion test by checking RSTB_EVENT flag after external reset.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_RSTB_EVENT_RESET_OCCURRED check verifies RSTB assertion test succeeded

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog trigger shall verify good watchdog refresh by checking GRL_FLAGS register.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_FS_WD_G_GOOD_WD_REFRESH checked after watchdog refresh

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog shall diagnose bad watchdog refresh timing or data errors.
requirements.rationale: BAD_WD_TIMING and BAD_WD_DATA flags checked on watchdog refresh failure

requirements.content: The SBC shall monitor ignition signal (WAKE1) and transition to standby mode on falling edge.
requirements.rationale: FS85_CheckIgnitionSignal monitors WAKE1 and calls FS85_GoToStandby on falling edge

requirements.content: The ignition signal monitoring shall be configurable via useIgnitionForPowerDown flag.
requirements.rationale: useIgnitionForPowerDown configuration flag controls ignition signal monitoring

requirements.content: The FS85 SPI communication shall use CRC8 with polynomial 0x1D for data integrity.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_COM_CRC_POLYNOM = 0x1D and FS8x_COM_CRC_INIT = 0xFF for CRC calculation

requirements.content: The FS85 SPI communication frame shall be 4 bytes with format: CRC, Data LSB, Data MSB, Address/Command.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_COMM_FRAME_SIZE = 4 bytes defines SPI frame length

requirements.content: The FS85 SPI communication shall validate received CRC and return error on mismatch.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_CheckCRC called on received frame with error returned on mismatch

requirements.content: The FS85 register write during INIT_FS shall write to both register and NOT register addresses.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WriteRegisterInit writes DATA to address and ~DATA to address+1

requirements.content: The FS85 simple watchdog mode shall use configured seed value for refresh.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WD_TYPE = FS8x_WD_SIMPLE uses drvData->watchdogSeed for refresh

requirements.content: The FS85 default watchdog seed value shall be 0x5AB2.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WD_SEED_DEFAULT = 0x5AB2 defined as default watchdog seed
